'''Taisham 23 (January 13)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
Recuring - In [[Ebou Dar]] the [[Feast of the Half Moon]] is celebrated. It's the end of six days of celebrations that include the [[Festival of Birds]] (Taisham 18), the [[Feast of Embers]] (Taisham 20) and [[Maddin's Day]] (Taisham 22).
